description: Runs deterministic Thunderbird mailbox operations against a local mailbox state file. Operations execute sequentially within one action.

actions.name: switch_folder
actions.description: Open a mailbox folder and focus its first visible message, if any.

actions.name: select_message
actions.description: Select a specific message and open its preview pane.

actions.name: set_read
actions.description: Mark a message read or unread.

actions.name: move_message
actions.description: Move a message to another folder and focus it there.

actions.name: archive_message
actions.description: Move a message into Archive and mark it read.

actions.name: restore_message
actions.description: Restore a message from Trash into another folder.

actions.name: add_tag
actions.description: Add a message tag if it is not already present.

actions.name: remove_tag
actions.description: Remove a message tag when it is present.

actions.name: create_draft_reply
actions.description: Open a reply draft addressed to the sender of the source message.

actions.name: create_draft
actions.description: Open a fresh draft with explicit recipient, subject, and body values.

actions.name: update_draft
actions.description: Update subject, body, or recipient fields on the open draft.

actions.name: send_draft
actions.description: Send the current draft and place the resulting message in Sent.

done_action.description: Return this action when the mailbox already satisfies the task.

tips: Bundle related mailbox edits into one action by listing them in `params.operations` in execution order.
Use `switch_folder` after a move, archive, delete, restore, or send when the success criteria mention a visible folder outcome.
Use `create_draft_reply` for replies or `create_draft` for a fresh message, then `update_draft`, then `send_draft`.
Tags are plain strings such as `Follow Up`, `Finance`, or `Urgent`.
After the observation matches the success criteria, return the done action.
